name: PARDUS Uragano EVO gravel build
why_interesting: An exact-model build supplies unusually detailed drivetrain compatibility, while a dated independent review adds 45 mm clearance and extensive mounting evidence.
missing: Current official exact-generation product page and stock complete-bike BOM
Current mainland price and exact EVO stock state
Exact EVO warranty duration and claim conditions

facts.drivetrain: Custom SRAM Apex AXS controls with X1 Eagle AXS rear derailleur, 40T and 11-50
facts.brakes: SRAM Apex AXS hydraulic, flat-mount 160 mm
facts.complete_weight_basis: BIKETO reviewed build reference only: Apex AXS/X1 Eagle AXS without pedals. This does not establish the custom/community build weight, which remains unresolved.
facts.frame: Carbon frame reported in the dated BIKETO review
facts.mounts: Front and rear rack, fork, bottle and fender mounts
facts.support_route: PARDUS China customer-service contact page and dealer locator; exact-generation warranty duration and claim eligibility remain unverified
facts.frame_material: Community listing's exact frame/material mapping remains unresolved; the current BIKETO Uragano EVO review separately describes its 2023 sample as HS-grade carbon, without proving the community build is that revision.
facts.frame_stiffness_status: Unresolved for this community build. BIKETO describes its reviewed 2023 Uragano EVO sample as firm on coarse gravel, but this is subjective, unmeasured, and not mapped to the community bike.

source_note:
Official mainland dealer and marketplace routes are established for the family, but the current official catalog exposes Uragano RX600 and Sport rather than an EVO page. BIKETO measured the documented Apex AXS/X1 Eagle AXS review build at 9.65 kg without pedals; a separate sold-out foreign Rival XPLR size-M build was listed at about 9.0 kg. Neither value establishes a current mainland stock build. The detailed public-post component list remains a custom build, not a factory configuration. Support-route review on 2026-09-22 confirms the manufacturer contact and dealer route only; it does not extend the dated build evidence or establish warranty coverage.

Batch 36 recheck: the current BIKETO review describes HS-grade carbon and firm ride tuning on its 2023 Uragano EVO sample; it does not identify the community build's generation or exact frame. Do not transfer material or stiffness claims to that custom build as established facts.
